name: gpui-vue-monorepo
description: Native GPU-accelerated Vue 3 renderer for Zed's GPUI

scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun --filter gpui-vue build && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' build
scripts.build:binaries: bun run build:native && bun --filter gpui-vue build && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' build:binary
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && cargo check --workspace --all-features
scripts.format: oxfmt --write packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test packages/gpui-vue/package.json packages/gpui-vue-native/package.json examples web scripts .github AGENTS.md README.md package.json vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts rust-toolchain.toml Cargo.toml crates/gpui-vue-core/Cargo.toml .cargo/config.toml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test packages/gpui-vue/package.json packages/gpui-vue-native/package.json examples web scripts .github AGENTS.md README.md package.json vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts rust-toolchain.toml Cargo.toml crates/gpui-vue-core/Cargo.toml .cargo/config.toml .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json
scripts.lint: oxlint --vue-plugin --deny-warnings packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test examples web scripts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --vue-plugin --fix packages/gpui-vue/src packages/gpui-vue/test examples web scripts vite.examples.config.mts vite.pages.config.mts
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter gpui-vue typecheck && bun --filter gpui-vue build && bun --filter '@gpui-vue/example-*' typecheck && bun packages/gpui-vue/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json
